items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: In Allen's band? No, I don't. No more than Old Man Allen.

ctx.x: Yeah. Do you remember any of the guys in the band other than him?
In Allen's band? No, I don't. No more than Old Man Allen.
In the picture I think they have Jack Carey and George E. Simms, Papa Solistan, Joe Highwood.
